---
title: "Component gallery"
description: >
  A Shiny app in the repository that shows every bslibreact component next
  to the bslib original, with the source of each version.
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = FALSE)
```

The repository includes a gallery app that shows 42 components, each one
three ways, side by side, with its full source underneath. It is the
quickest way to see that a bslibreact component looks and behaves like the
bslib original, and to copy the code for one.

![The gallery showing the slider example: the same slider and histogram in
three columns, with each version's app.R
below.](https://www.samuelbharti.com/bslibreact/assets/gallery-slider.png)

## The three columns

Every example is the same small app, built three times:

| Column | The app | Needs Node |
| --- | --- | --- |
| bslib + Shiny | Plain bslib and Shiny, for comparison. | No |
| bslibreact from npm | The page written in TSX and bundled with Vite. | Yes |
| bslibreact from the R package | The same page, hand written against the prebuilt bundle the R package ships. | No |

The second and third columns run the same server code. Their `app.R` files
differ in one line: the page of the third also attaches `bslibreact_dep()`, the
prebuilt bundle.

The examples follow the layout of the [Shiny component
gallery](https://shiny.posit.co/r/components/): 25 inputs, 12 outputs, and 5
messages such as modals, tooltips and notifications.

![The gallery showing the value box example: the same value box in all
three
columns.](https://www.samuelbharti.com/bslibreact/assets/gallery-value-box.png)

## Run it

The gallery is one Shiny app. Each built client is committed, so it runs
without Node:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/samuelbharti/bslibreact.git
```

```{r}
install.packages(c(
  "pak", "shinyreact", "callr", "curl",
  "DT", "reactable", "gt", "leaflet", "plotly"
))
pak::pak("samuelbharti/bslibreact/pkg-r")
shiny::runApp("bslibreact/gallery")
```

Pick an example in the sidebar. The gallery starts that example's three apps
in the background, which takes a second or two the first time, and keeps the
most recent ones running.

## Read the source

The code panel under each column shows the real files of that version, so
what is shown is what runs. The files are in the repository under
`gallery/apps/<example>/`:

| Folder | Holds |
| --- | --- |
| `classic/` | `app.R`, plain bslib and Shiny. |
| `vite/` | `app.R`, `src/App.tsx`, and the built `www/ui.js`. |
| `rpkg/` | `app.R` and a hand-written `www/ui.js`. |
